description: This file defines the Suggest interface for a dictionary suggestion system in an Android keyboard application, including methods for managing suggestions, user dictionary, and modes.

classes.name: Suggest
classes.description: An interface for managing suggestions in a keyboard application, including methods for setting correction modes, retrieving suggestions, and managing user dictionaries.

classes.name: Suggest.AdditionType
classes.description: An enum representing the type of addition for new words, with associated frequency delta values.

methods.name: setCorrectionMode
methods.description: Configures the suggestion correction mode with options for enabling suggestions, maximum length difference, maximum distance, and whether to split words.

methods.name: setupSuggestionsForKeyboard
methods.description: Sets up suggestions using a list of dictionary builders and a background loader callback.

methods.name: setMaxSuggestions
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of suggestions to generate, with validation for range.

methods.name: resetNextWordSentence
methods.description: Resets the sentence context for next word suggestions.

methods.name: getNextSuggestions
methods.description: Returns a list of suggested next words based on the previous word and case state.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Returns a list of suggestions based on the current WordComposer.

methods.name: getLastValidSuggestionIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the last valid suggestion.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a given word is valid.

methods.name: addWordToUserDictionary
methods.description: Adds a word to the user dictionary.

methods.name: removeWordFromUserDictionary
methods.description: Removes a word from the user dictionary.

methods.name: setTagsSearcher
methods.description: Sets the tags extractor for suggestions.

methods.name: tryToLearnNewWord
methods.description: Attempts to learn a new word with a specified addition type.

methods.name: isIncognitoMode
methods.description: Checks if incognito mode is active.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the Suggest instance, releasing resources.
